items.name: ACN-Data-Analysis
items.description: California Institute of Technology provides ACN-DATA to help researchers access real data around electric vehicle charging. Here I have analysed the data and verified some of the user behaviour mentioned in "ACN-Data : Analysis and Applications of an Open EV Charging Dataset" paper. The link of the paper is : https://ev.caltech.edu/assets/pub/ACN_Data_Analysis_and_Applications.pdf
